name: Votivkino
notes: combines /programm/tag/?date=YYYYMMDD (per-day showtimes, iterated up to 21 days or horizon whichever is smaller since real daily listings thin out after ~2 weeks), /specials/ (further-out one-off special-series screenings with actual dates/times, through ~2 months), and /vorschau/ (announced-but-unscheduled premieres, added only as a single date-only placeholder record for films not otherwise seen); Bellaria Kino showtimes appear interleaved on the same pages (class showtime_kino_bellaria, CSS-hidden for logged-out users) and are deliberately skipped since bellariakino has its own scraper slug; no genre/category field exists on the site so category is the marketing strand label ('Primetime', 'Sleazy Sunday', 'Game: On!', etc.) or null; no per-showtime price is published so price_min/price_text always null
